newsitem.title: UK: SNOOKER-HENDRY FIGHTS BACK TO LEAD QUARTER-FINAL 9-7.
newsitem.headline: SNOOKER-HENDRY FIGHTS BACK TO LEAD QUARTER-FINAL 9-7.

text.p: Defending champion Stephen Hendry won six of the eight evening frames to lead Darren Morgan 9-7 in their best-of-25 frames world snooker championship quarter-final on Tuesday.
Hendry, seeking a record seventh world title, is never more dangerous when his back is to the wall as Welshman Morgan found after opening a 5-3 lead during the day's opening session.
A break of 77 in the ninth frame set the pattern for Hendry's comeback and scores of 46, 54, 71 and 99 followed as the 28-year-old Scot swept 8-6 ahead.
Morgan enjoyed a break of 90 in the penultimate frame to trail 8-7 and appeared set to draw level overnight when 49-0 up in the last.
But when he ran out of position the predatory Hendry pounced with a 74 break to move two frames ahead.
Canadian Alain Robidoux also held a 9-7 lead in his quarter-final against Welsh outsider Lee Walker.
Both matches will be completed on Wednesday.
